note: contrat d'achat du 2 juin 2020 (effectif au 1er juin) : 1 000 mineurs Antminer S19 Pro livrés en deux lots (fin septembre et fin octobre 2020), aux conditions des contrats de mai 2020 ; prix payé comptant (ligne suivante)
quote: On June 2, 2020, Riot Blockchain, Inc. ("Riot," "us," "we," "our," or the "Corporation"), entered into a sale and purchase agreement (the "Agreement") with Bitmaintech PTE, LTD ("Bitmain") effective as of June 1, 2020, for the purchase of 1,000 additional Antminer S19 Pro digital currency miners (the "Miners").

note: prix des 1 000 S19 Pro payé sur la trésorerie avant livraison (entre la signature et le 8-K du 5 juin 2020)
quote: Riot paid Bitmain approximately US$2.3 million (subject to adjustments, offsets and costs as set forth in the Agreement) from its cash on hand to purchase these new Miners.
